semanticReview.method: Follow-up semantic review against publicly accessible official Taiwanese MOE dictionary entries and/or open scholarly records. Each locator is restricted to the exact entry, section, or abstract checked; no inference from a source title.
findings: La ficha presenta elipsis de objeto recuperable y usa Ø como notación analítica, aclarando que no representa palabra pronunciada.
Ke (2025) §Abstract 對 null object 的解釋提出 topic-bound variable 分析，明言允許與否受特定條件限制，反駁「僅語境可恢復即可省略」的簡化說法。
例句「這本書我看過，也推薦給朋友了」及其推薦的省略賓語未在來源中以該句出現。
limitations: Falta fuente sintáctica para la relación entre tópico, anáfora, argumento nulo y objeto elidido; continuidad discursiva y recuperabilidad necesitan ejemplos controlados.
目前來源不支持這個具體動詞鏈和所有可恢復語境；需對「推薦」及零賓語限制的語料/實驗證據。
The cited source(s) support only a subset of claims; the listed examples and broad generalizations remain uncited or require fuller primary-source locators.
